answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint cheap voting keys from one purse and treat each clone as independent. Mechanism: lock a 31 POA ridge stake and collect 4 of 5 lookout receipts along a dune trail to reach the reputation summit. Every 18 minutes a post flashes a one-shot signal the climber has 75s to countersign. Each extra sibling from the same cluster adds 31*k^1.55 POA (~168 POA for a third clone). Verification: peers rebuild the five-bit lookout bitmap from on-ledger receipts. Failure: missing two signals burns 30% of the stake; shared 35ms replies slash both bonds 65% as collusion.
